hero.subtitle: For shops, KOCs, and KOLs: turn one product video into many sales-ready clips for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts — without rebuilding every post from scratch.

featuresSection.label: Features
featuresSection.title: Sales videos, without the editing headache
featuresSection.subtitle: Not a complicated film editor. Built to help you turn footage you already have into more product clips you can post.

features.title: One product video → many posts
features.description: Add your product footage, then cut it into different versions: different openings, highlights, and lengths. Enough clips to post regularly without filming again.

features.title: Ready-made templates for shops & creators
features.description: Common sales formats are ready to use: unboxing, quick review, before/after, product demo, and buy-now close. Pick a template, drop in your video, export for selling platforms.

features.title: Captions and talk that help sell
features.description: Trim stumbles and add captions that call out price, offers, and product benefits — so people scrolling on their phone get it fast and are more likely to buy.
bullets: Captions that highlight price, offers, and key benefits.
Clearer voice for reviews and clips cut from livestreams.

features.title: Make each clip feel different
features.description: Change pacing, framing, and light effects so clips from the same footage don’t look identical — useful when you sell many products or post on several channels.
